packageRules.description: This is an application: nobody depends on its version floors, so they follow the locked versions.
build-system.requires is not recorded in uv.lock, so widen the bound instead.
One pull request for every non-major Python update.
One pull request for GitHub Actions. Digests stay pinned and the trailing # vX.Y.Z comment is kept in sync.
One pull request for pre-commit hook revisions.
One pull request for the container images of the Containerfile and of the development compose file.
uv builds the project with its bundled backend only when its version matches the uv_build range, so the uv of setup-uv, the uv container image and that range move together.
GitHub runner labels have no release date, so the cooldown would hold them forever.
Major updates are never grouped and never automerged.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly full refresh of uv.lock, which is the only way transitive dependencies ever move.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule and the 14 day cooldown, and always wait for a human.
